approvers: my wife, my tax adviser and lawyer, my house bank
reason: The terms read decently and the staff guarantee matters to me, but nobody has ever sold to these people and I have 24 employees and forty years in this firm. I will have a coffee with them, but I will not hand over my life's work to a newcomer without a track record.
objection: They have no earlier sellers I can call. I would be the first, and if it goes wrong my staff and my name pay for it. And 3.5x to 4.5x EBITDA is lower than what I hope for; others will pay more in cash at closing.
instead: Keep running the business, keep listing quietly on nexxt-change, talk to my adviser and to the established buyers, and wait for a better cash offer.
would_change_my_mind: A higher price, 100% cash at closing or the full price in escrow, and a reference from a seller who has already sold to them, or a known, established backer I can check.
